alpaca_fixture_account_environment.acceptance_condition: The fixture validates against https://paper-api.alpaca.markets; the same production-grade lifecycle is exercised as live.
alpaca_fixture_account_environment.current_state: Paper is selected for the backend-owned connected Dev fixture; credentials have not yet been bootstrapped.
alpaca_fixture_account_environment.required_action: Backend owner confirms the protected fixture input and completes local bootstrap.

alpaca_fixture_credential_pair.acceptance_condition: Credentials validate against the selected paper host and are stored only as a pinned Secret Manager version.
alpaca_fixture_credential_pair.current_state: No real Alpaca credential pair has been loaded through the protected local bootstrap flow.
alpaca_fixture_credential_pair.required_action: Backend owner supplies one real Alpaca paper-account credential pair locally; frontend must never receive this fixture secret.

closed_alpha_campaign_scope.acceptance_condition: Identifier is bound to the approved invite-only U.S. Alpha cohort and release evidence.
closed_alpha_campaign_scope.current_state: The final invite-only Alpha campaign/cohort identifier is not selected.
closed_alpha_campaign_scope.required_action: Backend owner selects the opaque campaign identifier at release approval.

dev_service_revisions_and_image_digests.acceptance_condition: Every required service revision is Ready, receives intended traffic and resolves to the recorded immutable image digest.
dev_service_revisions_and_image_digests.current_state: Current provisioned revisions are development checkpoints, not the accepted connected-Alpha release set.
dev_service_revisions_and_image_digests.required_action: Backend records the final service revisions and immutable image digests after parallel deployment and acceptance.

frontend_bff_jwks_url.acceptance_condition: HTTPS GET returns 200 with a valid JWKS containing at least one unique usable ES256 public key, and signed test assertions pass new-kid refresh and rotation checks.
frontend_bff_jwks_url.current_state: The URL is agreed and the BFF base is reachable, but a 2026-09-03 probe of this JWKS route returned HTTP 503.
frontend_bff_jwks_url.required_action: Frontend deploys the BFF assertion JWKS at this already-selected URL; no new URL decision is requested.

frontend_identity_redirect_uris.acceptance_condition: Array is non-empty, unique, exact and every URI is HTTPS with no credentials or fragment.
frontend_identity_redirect_uris.current_state: No exact frontend identity callback allowlist has been supplied.
frontend_identity_redirect_uris.required_action: Frontend supplies every exact HTTPS redirect URI used by the Dev BFF identity flow.

frontend_upstream_identity_audience.acceptance_condition: Value is non-empty, at most 256 characters and matches a verified Dev assertion exactly.
frontend_upstream_identity_audience.current_state: No exact upstream user-identity token audience has been supplied.
frontend_upstream_identity_audience.required_action: Frontend supplies the exact aud value emitted for the identity assertion sent to identity-ccid.

frontend_upstream_identity_issuer.acceptance_condition: Exact HTTPS issuer is stable in Dev and matches a cryptographically verified test assertion.
frontend_upstream_identity_issuer.current_state: No exact upstream user-identity token issuer has been supplied.
frontend_upstream_identity_issuer.required_action: Frontend supplies the exact HTTPS iss claim emitted for the identity assertion sent to identity-ccid.

frontend_upstream_identity_jwks_url.acceptance_condition: HTTPS GET returns a valid JWKS containing at least one unique usable ES256 public key and supports bounded rotation testing.
frontend_upstream_identity_jwks_url.current_state: The upstream user-identity JWKS endpoint is distinct from the BFF assertion JWKS and is not yet supplied.
frontend_upstream_identity_jwks_url.required_action: Frontend supplies the exact HTTPS JWKS URL for verifying upstream user-identity assertions.

frontend_upstream_identity_provider_id.acceptance_condition: Matches [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,31} and identifies the same provider as the supplied issuer, audience and JWKS.
frontend_upstream_identity_provider_id.current_state: The frontend identity product/provider has not been identified in the handoff facts.
frontend_upstream_identity_provider_id.required_action: Frontend supplies the stable lowercase provider identifier used to namespace the upstream identity mapping.

identity_ccid_base_url.acceptance_condition: BFF can invoke the identity exchange with the required Google audience and positive/negative trust tests pass.
identity_ccid_base_url.current_state: Cloud Run service and revision are Ready, but IDENTITY_FEATURE_STATE is disabled and frontend trust inputs are blank.
identity_ccid_base_url.required_action: Backend binds verified frontend trust, deploys the accepted revision and activates the Alpha feature state.

identity_ccid_jwks_url.acceptance_condition: Unauthenticated HTTPS GET returns 200 with only supported public ES256 keys and bounded cache headers; identity-result verification and rotation pass.
identity_ccid_jwks_url.current_state: The public route and KMS-backed signing implementation exist, but unauthenticated access returned HTTP 403 on 2026-09-03.
identity_ccid_jwks_url.required_action: Backend exposes this JWKS route without a Google credential while retaining application-level authentication on protected identity routes.

investor_api_base_url.acceptance_condition: The authorized BFF can invoke all package routes with both credentials and negative caller/user/ownership tests pass.
investor_api_base_url.current_state: Cloud Run service and revision are Ready, but INVESTOR_API_FEATURE_STATE is disabled and the BFF assertion JWKS is unbound.
investor_api_base_url.required_action: Backend binds the operational frontend BFF JWKS, deploys the accepted revision and activates only the approved Alpha scope.

real_connected_fixture_ids.acceptance_condition: Identifiers resolve through the package routes for the owning fixture user and uniformly fail for another user.
real_connected_fixture_ids.current_state: No real connected fixture journey has produced the account-safe identifier set.
real_connected_fixture_ids.required_action: Backend runs the protected real paper-account journey and records only safe opaque fixture identifiers.

support.escalation_channel.acceptance_condition: Both teams verify access and the permitted escalation-field policy.
support.escalation_channel.current_state: No shared secure escalation channel reference is recorded.
support.escalation_channel.required_action: Frontend and backend agree a secure channel that excludes credentials, tokens and prohibited payloads.

support.integration_contact.acceptance_condition: Both teams acknowledge the contact reference and delivery channel.
support.integration_contact.current_state: No joint day-to-day integration contact reference is recorded.
support.integration_contact.required_action: Frontend and backend each identify an integration contact and agree the reference included in the addendum.

support.security_contact.acceptance_condition: Both teams acknowledge the contact reference and protected communication path.
support.security_contact.current_state: No joint security contact reference is recorded.
support.security_contact.required_action: Frontend and backend agree the contact used for credential, token, JWKS and data-security escalation.

support.trading_operations_contact.acceptance_condition: Contact and response path are verified and included in the hash-bound addendum.
support.trading_operations_contact.current_state: The backend trading-operations contact has not been published for the Alpha connection addendum.
support.trading_operations_contact.required_action: Backend publishes the trading-operations contact before connected acceptance.

wif_allowed_audiences.acceptance_condition: Contains 1-10 unique non-whitespace values, each at most 256 characters, and a real token matches one allowed value.
wif_allowed_audiences.current_state: No allowed WIF workload-token audiences have been supplied.
wif_allowed_audiences.required_action: Frontend supplies the bounded audience set emitted for its deployed BFF workload tokens.

wif_allowed_subjects.acceptance_condition: Array is non-empty and unique; each subject is 1-127 non-whitespace characters and negative subjects fail impersonation.
wif_allowed_subjects.current_state: No immutable frontend BFF workload subjects have been supplied; the backend therefore creates no provider or impersonation grant.
wif_allowed_subjects.required_action: Frontend supplies the exact immutable sub claim value for each Dev BFF workload identity that may impersonate the fixed BFF service account.

wif_oidc_issuer.acceptance_condition: Issuer is stable, HTTPS and matches the iss claim in a real frontend workload token.
wif_oidc_issuer.current_state: The WIF pool exists, but its OIDC provider cannot be created until the frontend workload issuer is known.
wif_oidc_issuer.required_action: Frontend supplies the exact HTTPS issuer used by its deployed BFF workload identity tokens.

wif_provider_name.acceptance_condition: Provider resource is ACTIVE and only the approved subjects can impersonate the fixed BFF service account; negative subjects are denied.
wif_provider_name.current_state: The WIF pool is ACTIVE but has zero providers; no frontend identity can impersonate the BFF service account.
wif_provider_name.required_action: Backend creates the fixed provider and restricted impersonation grants after validating the frontend issuer, allowed audiences and immutable subjects.

rules: A null value is genuinely not yet supplied or produced and must not be guessed.
A non-null value with a non-ready value_state is selected or provisioned but must not be treated as operational.
Only frontend_required_actions are requests to the frontend team.
Backend outputs become operational only in a later hash-bound connection addendum after their acceptance conditions pass.
